_about: The ecchi-meter on the Lust tab. Each stage shows one of its phrases at random on every pump of the bellows, from the coldest stage to the hottest. Innuendo only: nothing explicit, and nothing about minors or school-age tropes. Edit, add or reorder freely; the last stage's 'bonk' text shows when the meter maxes out, then the fire resets.
